caption: W.F. Denning. “Positions of the Perseid Radiant Point, July 15, to August 20.” From “The Observed Motion and Duration of the Radiant Point of the Perseids.” Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (December 1901: 161-169). 168.
alt: A star chart, white on black, tracing the moving radiant of the Perseid meteors as a line of small circles, each dated, from mid-July through August, through the constellations Andromeda, Perseus and Cassiopeia.
bibliography: Denning, W. F. "Positions of the Perseid Radiant Point, July 15 to August 20." "The Observed Motion and Duration of the Radiant Point of the Perseids," Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society, Dec. 1901, pp. 161–169.
